reader.requirement: At 1985 UNSTRING literal-1/literal-2 (DELIMITED BY and OR operands) must be nonnumeric literals - so numeric literals (integer, signed, decimal, also after the ALL phrase) are refused - and must not be a figurative constant beginning with ALL (only reachable after the ALL phrase, as ALL ALL x), while nonnumeric literals and figuratives such as SPACE, ZERO, QUOTE and a symbolic-character, with or without the ALL phrase, stay legal.
